description: Add full RFC 4518 §2.3 NFKC normalization to NormalizedIter. Requires adding unicode-normalization crate. Currently NormalizedIter only ASCII-case-folds. Spec: RFC 4518 §2.2 (map), §2.3 (NFKC), §2.4 (prohibit), §2.5 (bidi). Scope: apply after any_to_str_bytes extracts the string bytes; use unicode_normalization::UnicodeNormalization::nfkc() on the str. Also add Step 2 mapping (soft hyphen U+00AD removal, control character removal per RFC 3454). Testing: need Unicode test vectors from RFC 4518 or LDAP conformance suite.
title: Unicode NFKC normalization in names_match
